notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional attribute source-association replacement surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that a queued update retains its original source-region association while a later update uses the explicitly replaced association, including reflection-before-grant and cleanup boundaries without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional attribute association and replacement services with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection and grant callbacks
